1_build.detail: `taskset -c 0-11 lake env lean scaffold/GXScaffold/BTZ/VirtTame.lean` exits 0 in 40.9 s wall, with no errors and no warnings at all. The two unusedSimpArgs warnings of the earlier audit are gone. Real sorry count: 0. The file has no `sorry`, `admit`, `axiom`, `native_decide` or `implemented_by`; it does have six `set_option maxHeartbeats … in` lines, which are harmless. The VirtTame .olean (19:46:56) is newer than the source (19:45:10), and Rigid.olean is newer than Rigid.lean, which fits the REPORT's module-only `lake build`; I did not rebuild, to stay write-free. `#print axioms` was run through `lake env lean --stdin` on twelve declarations: isAnalyticModelFamily_ePaper, isAnalyticModelFamily_eFam, not_isAnalyticModelFamily_two_pi, btz_manifold_virt_tame, btz_xaManifold_virt_tame, btz_manifold_galoisian_maximal, btz_xaManifold_galoisian_maximal, btz_manifold_tilde_isLocallyBTZTilde, mass_sing, mass_to_mass, mass_to_btz_false and mass_exists_aut. All twelve give [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] only. So the Models dependencies used (isVirtuallyTame_of_hasMaximalLifts → isVirtuallyTame_of_descending, maxBranched_isGaloisian) and WP-41b/41c's btz_hasAutContinuousTamifying and btzE0_localUnique_core are sorry-free transitively.

detail: ex:follows_proposition_brunswic_cauchy (l.1927, DEC-74). isAnalyticModelFamily_ePaper has no hypotheses. It is indexed by {θ : ℝ // 0 ≤ θ ∧ θ ≠ 2π}, with θ = 0 ↦ BTZE0 and θ > 0 ↦ MassModel θ = Γ_θ\(𝔻_∞ × ℝ), developed by massDevM (t, r e^{iθ̃}) with holonomy massRot (k·θ) (massDevM_smul); this is DEC-47's intended massive particle, massive cones of every angle θ > 0, θ ≠ 2π, included. The structure on MassModel θ is the unique one making the projection an a.e. morphism (mass_existsUnique is an ∃!, so Classical.choose in massStructure is harmless). S_θ = sing(E_θ) is the strongest choice, and it is non-empty: mass_sing gives the whole axis, also for θ ∈ 2πℤ∖{2π}. IsAnalyticModelFamily (Models l.512) is the faithful def:family_singular_manifolds_endowed: φ ranges over every homeomorphism of connected opens that is an a.e. morphism, and isAnalyticModelFamily_iff gives the printed single clause. All four type pairs are discharged: (none,none) by rfl; (none,some) via φ.symm and mass_to_btz_false; (some,none) by mass_to_btz_false; (some,some) by mass_to_mass, whose θ = θ' needs no extra hypothesis beyond the facts chartExt_facts derives from φ. exists_aut is btzE0_exists_aut / mass_exists_aut, with no hypothesis beyond the analyticity clause's. B21 Prop 1.3 (2108.12631 BTZ_1.tex prop:isom: α, β ∈ ℝ₊, α ≠ 2π) is BUILT here, not assumed (DEC-23). The θ = 2π counterexample is non-vacuous: IsMassStructure (2π) is inhabited by exists_isMassStructure (2π ≠ 0), LocallyConnectedSpace follows from mass_instances, and mass_two_pi_sing_eq_empty shows sing(E_{2π}) = ∅. `closed` with the bold mark is consistent with DEC-27, because DEC-74 rules the corrected index set.

prop:BTZ_manifold_virt_tame (l.2262). btz_manifold_virt_tame assumes IsBTZSingModelled M: every singular point is the centre of an E₀-chart. That is l.2300's gloss and IsXAManifold.hasType exactly, so it is weaker than IsXAManifold (DEC-67 (e)), whose form btz_xaManifold_virt_tame is a corollary; the weakening is reported (⚠ weakened). The standing instances are DEC-66 (a)(b)(c). The conclusion is the full IsVirtuallyTame. Every hypothesis of isVirtuallyTame_of_hasMaximalLifts is checked in-file or upstream with 0 sorry: {E₀} analytic, E₀ locally Galoisian by radial contraction in cylHomeomorph coordinates (for EVERY open V), Aut(E₀~) T_BTZ-continuous, and box charts with maximal lifts via exists_homeomorph_maxBranched_of_simplyConnected (the regular part of a box's preimage is the convex log-polar box, hence contractible). Routing around the open general case of theo:local_virt_tame is legitimate here: DEC-82/86 refuse the descending form as the THEOREM's certificate, not as a route to this proposition, whose conclusion is fully proved. The hypothesis is satisfiable non-vacuously (E₀ itself, isXAManifold_model_of_sing_subset).

prop:manifold_admits_galoisian_maximal (l.2308), partial and unmarked. btz_manifold_galoisian_maximal proves the following for every base point y₀: (i) IsGaloisian (SpreadEnd.base) and branchingLocus = Sing M (exactly branched), with no hypothesis beyond IsBTZSingModelled; (ii) for every y₀ and every presentation Φ of E₀~ (one exists, btz_exists_presentation, which makes the ∀Φ non-vacuous), a tamifying topology T' and a T'-continuous developing map D (IsRegDevelopingOnReg) satisfying IsLocallyBTZTilde. IsLocallyBTZTilde is a genuine local identification at every singular point e of M̃: a lifted E₀-chart Ψ from the component V̂ ∋ f of q⁻¹(V) to the component Û ∋ e of p⁻¹(U), bijective, lifting c⁻¹, both components open (natural, and T_BTZ = Φ^*hornTop resp. T'), nhds-preserving for the natural topologies AND 𝓝_{T'}(Ψ v) = Ψ_*𝓝_{T_BTZ}(v), singular loci preserved, D∘Ψ = g·D_{E₀} on all of V̂. This settles the earlier audit's M1(a) (the third assertion is now stated and proved in a reading) and M1(b) (T' is pinned down chartwise to T_BTZ, not an arbitrary tamifying topology), and m2 (∀ y₀ everywhere). Two readings remain: the local reading of 'M̃ is a BTZ~-manifold' (no SingularGXStructure on (M̃,T') and no X_A-atlas), and 'continuous for T_BTZ' read as the glued chartwise-T_BTZ topology. Both are disclosed in SCOPE (c) and asked as questions, so `partial` is exactly right under DEC-27; with a ruling accepting them the row closes.

No vacuous, circular or unsatisfiable hypothesis was found, nor a hidden assumption carrying the conclusion. hΦ (Φ lifts the projection) is satisfied by btz_exists_presentation. DEC-55's compact-open reading enters only through IsLocallyGaloisian = IsSLSCInCC (the literal compact-open-component form); here it is obtained from the homotopy form via `.isSLSCInCC`, a proved implication, which is the direction DEC-55 allows.

issues.problem: A missing assertion and a weaker reading, both disclosed. (a) The third assertion, 'Furthermore, M̃ is a BTZ~-manifold' (l.2310), is not formalized at all: it has no statement and no tagged `sorry`. That breaks CAMPAIGN's state-first rule and kb/0011's 'choose a reading, disclose it, report it as a question'. REPORT itself says reading (i) is 'true by the box lifts': every singular point of M̃ with p^*B has a neighbourhood a.e.-isomorphic to an open of E₀~ around a singular point. HasMaximalLifts and the lifted box charts already provide the components. (b) 'a developing map continuous for the tamifying topology T_BTZ' is formalized as '∃ some tamifying topology T with a T-continuous D'. That is exactly btz_manifold_virt_tame's exists_extension and adds no content. Nothing identifies the glued topology with the topology T_BTZ induces chartwise on M̃, and l.2312 makes that topology the standing 'developing map' for the rest of §4.
issues.fix: State reading (i) as a theorem, both for the natural topology and for the glued tamifying topology (whose local pieces are by construction quotients of T_BTZ on E₀~ through the box descents), and prove it or leave a precisely tagged `sorry`. State the identification of the tamifying topology from btz_manifold_virt_tame with the chartwise T_BTZ topology (nhds of a lifted singular point = images of T_BTZ-nhds under the lifted box chart). Keep the row partial until the author rules on the BTZ~-manifold reading.

issues.problem: Only hM.hasType is ever used (lines 595, 663, 704); IsXAManifold.exists_atlas is never used. The theorems therefore hold under the l.2300 gloss 'singular locus locally modelled on E₀' alone. That is strictly weaker than IsXAManifold, because the atlas clause forces every regular point into an E₀-chart centred at a singular point. kb/0007 asks for the weakest sufficient hypotheses.
issues.fix: Either take `∀ y ∈ Sing M, ∃ a, HasXAType a y` as the hypothesis and keep IsXAManifold corollaries, or note in the checklist that the atlas clause is unused (⚠ weakened available).

issues.problem: The Galoisian/exact-branching conjunct holds for every base point y₀, but the tamifying-topology conjunct only gives ∃ y₀.
issues.fix: Optional: transport along the base-point change of MaxBranchedCover, or note the asymmetry in SCOPE.
